type get_molecular_weight = (_: {

type get_heavy_atom_count = (_: {

type get_mol_logp = (_: {

type get_tpsa = (_: {

type get_hbd = (_: {

type get_hba = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

type get_num_rotatable_bonds = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

type get_fraction_csp3 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

// Return Wildman–Crippen molar refractivity (MR).
type get_mol_mr = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return total ring count.
type get_ring_count = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

// Return aromatic ring count.
type get_num_aromatic_rings = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.

type get_formal_charge = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

type get_qed = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return heteroatom count (non C/H).
type get_num_heteroatoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Analyze fused ring systems (clusters of rings sharing bonds) and report their topology, aromaticity, and heteroatom content. Distinguishes fused polycyclic systems from isolated rings. // SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

type classify_ionization = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.

ph?: number
}) => any;

type compute_similarity = (_: {
// Query SMILES string.

}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.

type describe_high_level_fg_fragments = (_: {
// The SMILES string to parse.

type match_substructure = (_: {
// The SMILES string of the molecule. Do not pass in an ellipsis (`...`) or other abbreviation.

type find_mcs = (_: {
// Query SMILES.

// Reference SMILES to include in the MCS search.

type score_structural_alerts = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.

}) => any;

// Return Labute approximate surface area (ASA proxy).
type get_labute_asa = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Bertz complexity index.
type get_bertz_ct = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return IPC (information content).
type get_ipc = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Hall–Kier alpha.
type get_hall_kier_alpha = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Kappa1 shape index.
type get_kappa1 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Kappa2 shape index.
type get_kappa2 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Kappa3 shape index.
type get_kappa3 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_num_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return unspecified stereocenter count.
type get_num_unspecified_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_esol = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.

}) => any;
